# Cambrio

> Cambrio is a browser-based, private-room multiplayer memory card game for 2–8 friends.

## Play

- Create a private room from the home page and share its invite link.
- Join without a download or permanent account.
- Private room URLs are temporary and should not be indexed.

## Rules summary

- Remember hidden cards, draw or swap on your turn, and stack matching ranks in real time.
- Special powers are attached to 7 through Queen and black Kings.
- Red Kings score −1, there are no Jokers, and the lowest score wins.

## More information

- [Cambrio source and complete game specification](https://github.com/brian-aiad/Cambrio)
